purpose: Durable runtime for long-running agent workers — keeps agents alive, inspectable, and resumable through crashes, retries, and operator intervention.
current_focus: Operator-polish branch: production-mode hardening and operability surfaces.
working_agreements: The engine contract is two async methods (init_snapshot, step). Do not add lifecycle hooks without strong justification.
Engines must make step() retry-safe from the same snapshot — execution is at-least-once, not exactly-once.
Simple mode = Redis for both movement and memory. Production mode = Redis for movement, Postgres for memory. Do not blur this boundary.
Snapshots are the unit of durability; never mutate engine state outside a snapshot save.
Redis keys are movement infrastructure; Postgres tables are memory. Recovery paths must not depend on Redis in production mode.

README.md.purpose: Fast project orientation: thesis, engine contract, execution loop, storage modes.

ROADMAP.md.purpose: Execution sequence and what is explicitly not built yet (snapshot history, retention, audit log).

CHANGELOG.md.purpose: Release history; 0.2.0 unreleased covers Postgres production foundation.

pyproject.toml.purpose: Toolchain, entry points, optional [postgres] extra, ruff config (line-length 100).

docs/runtime-storage.md.purpose: Load-bearing architecture doc: Redis=movement, Postgres=memory, Object=evidence.

docs/.purpose: Operator-facing docs; runtime-storage.md is the most cited.

src/roost/cli.py.purpose: argparse CLI: init/doctor/enqueue/worker/status/dlq/ui. Primary entry point for operators.

src/roost/runtime/models.py.purpose: Core data model: WorkItem, Snapshot, Lease, Artifact. Read first when reasoning about correctness.

src/roost/runtime/engine.py.purpose: Engine Protocol — the two-method contract everything plugs into.

src/roost/runtime/stores.py.purpose: Store Protocol interfaces + Postgres implementations. Hot path for production correctness.

src/roost/runtime/swarm.py.purpose: _RedisSwarmRuntime: the execution loop, lease renewal, orphan recovery, CAS-on-version. Load-bearing runtime logic.

src/roost/runtime/backends/redis.py.purpose: Simple-mode stores: Redis Lua scripts for CAS, lease renew/release, resource claims.

src/roost/runtime/backends/postgres/.purpose: Production stores and SQL migrations. Single shared async connection (see known concurrency caveat).

src/roost/runtime/backends/postgres/migr.purpose: Initial schema: work_items, work_meta, snapshots (latest-only), artifacts, leases, claims, events, dlq, heartbeats, operator_actions.

src/roost/runtime/artifacts.py.purpose: FileArtifactStore: content-addressed (sha256) artifact storage on disk.

src/roost/runtime/workspaces.py.purpose: Git worktree/clone isolation per work item.

src/roost/engines/.purpose: Built-in engines (demo, watchlist). Pluggable via entry points roost.engines.

src/roost/engines/watchlist/engine.py.purpose: Reference engine: crash-safe URL checker producing a JSON evidence report.

src/roost/ui/server.py.purpose: Local console: aiohttp server on :8766 for inspecting work, events, DLQ.

tests/.purpose: pytest-asyncio suite; test_runtime_primitives.py is the orientation test. Note: 507 lines, zero concurrency/transaction tests — see knowledge/audit.md.

.seedrop/view/knowledge/audit.md.purpose: Line-verified maturity audit: what Roost guarantees today vs. what its docs claim. Read BEFORE any production-mode correctness work. Defines the P0/P1/P2 finding set the tasks are built from.

.seedrop/view/tasks/.purpose: Actionable, deployable fixes keyed to audit.md findings. TASK-DEPLOY-GATE.md is the index and sequencing plan.
